geeklist.title: Small Lot of Trains, Winsome's and Japanese Games - Shipping from Aus
geeklist.description:
Looking to clear out a few oddities en-masse that aren’t/won’t be getting played any time soon.
I am located in Melbourne Australia, however auction will be run in USD due to likely market demand and consistency. Whole dollars only, any non-denominated bids will be considered as USD.
Payment is accepted via PPF&F or G&S on request, with buyer to pay fee and conversion. Alternatively, bank transfer also accepted via payID. Postage worldwide available at buyers expense. Auspost will be used, Australia’s national postal service which has a good online calculator for postage cost and automatic tracking on our end. Auspost international uses weight to determine cost, so it should be relatively accurate +300 grams for packaging.
In addition, 2-4 USD to be added with purchases for relevant packaging for postage.
Locals welcome to pick up in City of Melbourne. Australian postage 18-23 AUD as usual pending box size.
Games are as described, if no additional comment added, consider them ‘as new’ relative to age.
Intending to run auction to 02/02/26, 12pm Aus EST. This translates to 01/02/26, 9pm US EST.
No sniper bids allowed so auction will extend 6 6 hours if any bids added within last 2 hours of auction.
I will contact all winners directly after to discuss options, noting it may take some time or organise and coordinate myself for postage. No payment will be required til I have coordinated all of the background stuff, but the game will be held for you in the meantime. Sales will be processed through the GeekMarket for BGG's 3% cut.
Additional photos available on request, and can be added to listing as required.
First auction so let me know if anything else is needed! May add additional games here or there throughout week.
